profile.headline: Web Application Developer
profile.summary: I'm a web application developer with over 20 years of experience.  Recently my experience has been working with Ruby on Rails, ColdFusion, among other skills as noted in my experience.  Also, creating WordPress websites with customizations.  Exploring the Google Data Analytics course.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Creating websites for small businesses.  Experienced at creating websites using WordPress, Squarespace, and Wix.  Installed themes and plugins to provide the functionality needed for each website.  Applied customizations using pure HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP tweaks when needed.  Edited logos and images to use on websites using Adobe Photoshop.  Provided consultation for technical decisions and recommendations for clients.

Documented and maintained ColdFusion web applications for KCPL during transfer of knowledge to new employees for support of intranet security, intranet home page, all of the web applications and websites the team supported.  Trained peers on support of various other client-server applications and interfaces.
Implemented and trained end-users at KCPL on SharePoint sites for compliance to uphold corporate initiatives.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description: Team member of advanced application developers using ColdFusion 9/10 and MS SQL Server 2014 to meet the requirements of issues in RubyMine KanBan board.  Helped port existing code base to Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL for the refaced web applications with an emphasis on improved user experience and accessibility.  Develop in Ruby on Rails app merging data from multiple state agencies for KSCareerNav.gov.  Used ETL to load seed data for small refaced application using the Kiba gem.  Assist in the development and application of coding standards/guidelines for development. Handle software administration of Linux, Redmine, and Git.  Review and test changes prior to sending to testers. Implement any changes found by the testers.  Perform code reviews of other staff to ensure coding guidelines are followed and best practices are maintained.  Meet with business analysts to discuss how to implement new requirements.  Developing areas of unit testing and business object design.  Implementing workforce management solutions and reporting solutions.   Perform other duties as assigned.  Contract-to-hire through Power IT from May 2013 to mid November 2013.

company.name: Kansas Dept of Commerce at America's Job Link Alliance (AJLA)

positions.title: Web Administrator
positions.description:
Manage all logistical aspects of the National Seminars web sites. This includes the migration of new technologies that enhance the ability of our customers to use the websites.  Management of the existing code base, investigation of any ongoing maintenance issues with the websites, documentation of the web team processes, management of webmaster correspondence and basic site enhancements to the websites. Implementation of applications that support the development team and enterprise such as Subversion, Jira. Crucible and Confluence.  Member of team developing complex object-oriented ColdFusion custom built online subscription training application utilizing the ColdBox framework and SQLServer 2005 database.  Creating report solutions for application administrators to provide for paying clients.
Webmaster for email support.  Upload code and graphics to production web servers.  Contract-to-hire through Power IT from August 2009 through April 2010.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description:
Lead the support team in resolving problems from clients concerning domain, hosting or email issues.   Setup and transferred website domains.  Implemented and maintained website design and content.  Some editing of print media files and Flash animations.
Installed numerous third-party and open-source software applications and plug-ins.  Joomla/Mambo Content Management System (CMS) and extensions, jQuery and plugins, Easy PHP Calendar, Slideshow Pro,  E-Mail Manager Pro,  Magento and OS Commerce online store. 
Utilized mobileStorm to create and send e-marketing campaigns.  
Performed employee training on office processes and procedures, server file structure and project management setup.  Answered multi-line phone system, performed account executive duties, and maintain Sugar Customer Resource Management system.
Perform client training on accessing email and the domain control panel, Joomla/Mambo CMS editing capabilities , sending newsletters with Email Manager Pro, installing and maintaining events in Easy PHP calendar.  
Created web based applications in PHP submitting form information into MySQL database.  
Creating customized backend weight management system using ColdFusion, jQuery and MySQL.  Created the application to utilize user roles as super administrator, company administrator, and user administrator levels to allow restrictive administrative functions.  The application also has points system for users to sign up for classes/events/campaigns for point redemption in the online store that was created.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Develop and maintain complex ColdFusion based web application on a FuseBox/Mach II framework utilizing programming languages such as AJAX, JavaScript, XML, and CSS. Creating DML SQL scripts, modifying stored procedures in a SQLserver 2005 database.   Contract-to-hire from January to May through Yoh, IT.

positions.title: Programmer Analayst
positions.description:
Enhanced user experience and productivity by developing, managing and maintaining intranet home page and numerous intranet websites and applications using HTML\DHTML, ColdFusion,  CSS, ASP, VBScript, JavaScript, Flash MX, Adobe Professional and Adobe Photoshop.
Upgraded and maintained Storm Emergency Restoration & Preparedness (SERP) a customized ColdFusion application.  Included implementation of e-mail and pager notification and Excel spreadsheet data upload.
Developed and supported numerous complex customized applications using PeopleTools, PeopleCode, ASP, VBScript, JavaScript, HTML and SQR in PeopleSoft HRMS system.
Assumed project lead in phase 2 of the development of a custom built ColdFusion application enabling the customer service department to better serve customers through an automated letter system that generated letters in PDF format.
Converted legacy web applications from ASP and PL\SQL to ColdFusion.
Involved in the testing and upgrade of 35+ web applications and websites during upgrade from ColdFusion 5 to ColdFusion 6 and later ColdFusion MX 7.
Created website administration application for high traffic corporate initiative website including file and image uploading and layout preview. 
Met executive needs by serving as key member of team involved in planning, designing, and implementing high profile SharePoint Windows SharePoint Service (WSS) sites which updated timelines for major corporate initiatives.
